chunks: Your ultimate destination is to four cubits.

key_terms.أَرْبَعَةِ أَذْرُعٍ: Four cubits, referring to the narrow measure of the grave
key_terms.مَصِيرُكُمْ: Your final destination or eventual return

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم mean by saying that your destination is four cubits?
ai.summary: This concise saying reminds people of the grave and the brevity of worldly life. It serves as an admonition to remember death and prepare for what comes after it.
